# Decision index

<!-- Generated by pnpm run decisions -- --write. Edit each decision’s YAML header instead. -->

Status describes applicability, not permission to reverse a decision. A satisfied revisit condition
needs separate owner authorization. Local evidence paths are checked; remote evidence links are
recorded without a network availability check.

Query the headers with `pnpm run decisions -- --json`, optionally adding `--status=needs-review`.
Regenerate this page with `pnpm run decisions -- --write`; `pnpm run lint` checks coverage,
metadata, links, cycles, & freshness. See [the metadata guide](decision-metadata.md) for the schema
& status meanings.

### [Dependency maintenance](decisions/2026-10-05-dependency-maintenance.md)

ID: 2026-10-05-dependency-maintenance. Status: Needs review.

Disable routine Dependabot version-update PRs for npm & GitHub Actions; retain security alerts &
security-update PRs. Batch routine upgrades with compatibility checks. Refresh the intended starting
branch before creating agent worktrees, defaulting to `main`; fetch its remote tip without modifying
the shared checkout.

Evidence:
[https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/issues/15904](https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/issues/15904).

Unresolved applicability: Does this decision still apply unchanged? Its owning implementation &
later resolutions were not revalidated while seeding issue #268.

### [Panel keyboard focus](decisions/2026-10-05-panel-focus.md)

ID: 2026-10-05-panel-focus. Status: Needs review.

Use one Svelte attachment for keyboard containment & Escape, and a shared overlay component for the
scrim & positioned wrapper. Callers choose initial focus & restoration policy through the overlay’s
optional focus attachment. mrh-is/mistria-fyi-private#446 revisits the initial implementation
because DOM attachment cleanup replaces previous-value effects while retaining picker suspension &
nested-dialog behavior. A stack limits nested attachments to the innermost panel; prevented events
remain owned by bits-ui dialogs.

Evidence:
[docs/decisions/2026-10-05-panel-focus.md#decision](../docs/decisions/2026-10-05-panel-focus.md#decision).

Unresolved applicability: Does this decision still apply unchanged? Its owning implementation &
later resolutions were not revalidated while seeding issue #268.

### [Category completion comes from progress](decisions/2026-10-06-category-completion.md)

ID: 2026-10-06-category-completion. Status: Needs review.

`isCategoryComplete(key, ctx)` in `engine/progress.ts` is the only category completion predicate,
defined as `getCategoryProgress(key, ctx).completed >= total`. Components call it instead of
re-deriving completion. Where the old progress count could reach 100% while the category was still
incomplete, the progress count changes rather than the predicate: each dateable villager now adds
one step for a settled relationship (platonic, or married with a declared child choice). The craving
quest's rule lives once, in `engine/craving-quest.ts`, and progress, search, & the quests page read
it.

Evidence:
[docs/decisions/2026-10-06-category-completion.md#decision](../docs/decisions/2026-10-06-category-completion.md#decision).

Unresolved applicability: Does this decision still apply unchanged? Its owning implementation &
later resolutions were not revalidated while seeding issue #268.

### [Pipeline diagnostic policy](decisions/2026-10-06-pipeline-diagnostics.md)

ID: 2026-10-06-pipeline-diagnostics. Status: Needs review.

Pass one run-scoped diagnostic collector through affected extractors & collectors, then validate it
before serialization or publication. Standalone callers validate a private collector before
returning. Every exception matches the full diagnostic kind, field path, target ID, & message, with
an explicit reason & real-asset evidence. Missing reviewed targets & obsolete overrides cannot be
allowlisted; exceptions no longer observed fail as obsolete.

session and writes nothing to the model's context.; An opt-in macOS launchd agent
(`pnpm run housekeeping:install`) runs hourly: refresh `main`, then apply the existing cleanup
script with a two-hour idle window.; The cleanup script keeps any worktree that a running process
uses as its working directory, and, given `--idle-minutes`, any worktree whose `HEAD` moved
recently.

### [Browser font fidelity](decisions/2026-10-08-browser-font-fidelity.md)

ID: 2026-10-08-browser-font-fidelity. Status: Needs review.

CI fetches `https://assets.mistria.fyi/fonts/satoshi-regular.woff2` before the accessibility suite
with `scripts/playwright-satoshi.ts`, which verifies a pinned SHA-256 and writes it to the
gitignored `tests/browser/fixtures/local/`. `actions/cache` keys the file on that script’s hash, so
changing the pinned hash refetches it. The shared fixture serves the file when present & aborts the
request otherwise. A geometry test asserts `document.fonts.check("1em Satoshi")` after loading; it
fails in CI and skips with a warning locally. Local runs fetch only when a developer runs the
script.

ID: 2026-10-13-no-implicit-dependency-installs. Status: Needs review.

stale dependencies instead of installing them. Installation happens only through
`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` or `node scripts/setup-worktree.ts`. The commands that must run
before dependencies exist, the machine doctor & worktree setup, lose their pnpm scripts and are
invoked with `node` directly, which also makes the doctor check the shell's real runtime.

### [Transfer codes bind to the exact app build](decisions/2026-10-13-transfer-build-binding.md)

ID: 2026-10-13-transfer-build-binding. Status: Needs review.

A transfer code starts with a four-byte CRC-32 fingerprint of the app version that created it
(SvelteKit’s `version`, which embeds the commit date & SHA in production). The scanner rejects any
code whose fingerprint differs from its own build as `version-mismatch` and tells the player to
update both devices. There is no transfer version, compatibility window, or decoding path for
another build’s layout. Backups & save import keep their explicit versions; they’re long-lived
artifacts, unlike a QR code.

Evidence:
[docs/decisions/2026-10-13-transfer-build-binding.md#decision](../docs/decisions/2026-10-13-transfer-build-binding.md#decision).

Unresolved applicability: Does this decision still apply unchanged? Its owning implementation &
later resolutions were not revalidated while seeding issue #268.

capabilities. Progress, the completion predicate, & the overall total read projections' totals.

ID: 2026-10-22-mistmare-perks. Status: Needs review.

menu's one tier. Each perk has a `horse_statue` source carrying that perk's own essence cost and the
mount it needs (`mountAppearanceId: "mistmare"`): `obj_horse_statue.gml` opens the perk menu only
once `ARI.mount` is set, so a player buys perks only after paying for the Mistmare. The perk shares
the Mistmare's visibility and renders its own `source_horse_statue_perk` message (“Buy at the Horse
Statue (200 essence) once you have the Mistmare”). Names come from `perks/<id>/name` and join the
skill perks in the `perks` locale chunk.

ID: 2026-10-22-perks-count-toward-completion. Status: Needs review.

Every perk is a completion step. A skill is complete at level 60 with every perk in its tiers
bought; the skills total counts each level and each perk as one step. The Mistmare's perks count
toward the animals total and the Mount section the same way.

Evidence:
[docs/decisions/2026-10-22-perks-count-toward-completion.md#decision](../docs/decisions/2026-10-22-perks-count-toward-completion.md#decision).

Unresolved applicability: Does this decision still apply unchanged? Its owning implementation &
later resolutions were not revalidated while seeding issue #268.

### [Dry-run feedback outside production](decisions/2026-10-27-feedback-preview-dry-run.md)

ID: 2026-10-27-feedback-preview-dry-run. Status: Needs review.

A Cloudflare Pages build of `main` is production; every other build runs feedback as a dry run.
`vite.config.ts` reads `CF_PAGES_BRANCH` at build time & defines `__PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT__`, which
`src/lib/server/deployment.ts` exports. The dry run keeps the origin, payload, & Turnstile token
checks, verifies Turnstile when its secret is set, & returns `{ dryRun: true }` without touching
GitHub or the email store. The panel shows a localized “Preview build” notice with no issue link.

Evidence:
[docs/decisions/2026-10-27-feedback-preview-dry-run.md#decision](../docs/decisions/2026-10-27-feedback-preview-dry-run.md#decision).

Unresolved applicability: Does this decision still apply unchanged? Its owning implementation &
later resolutions were not revalidated while seeding issue #268.

### [Row windows follow progress & spoilers](decisions/2026-10-27-row-windows.md)

ID: 2026-10-27-row-windows. Status: Needs review.

A source is “Later” while it or its row is a spoiler, while a progress gate the app already records
is unmet (`reachedSeason`, `quest`, `heartLevel`, `skillLevel`, `mineFloor`, `perkUnlocked`,
`hasUpperFloor`, `isDating`), or while it is out of season or weather. Otherwise it is “Now” when a
season or weather restriction holds today, & “Whenever” when nothing restricts it. A row takes its
best source: Now, then Whenever, then Later.

Evidence:
[docs/decisions/2026-10-27-row-windows.md#decision](../docs/decisions/2026-10-27-row-windows.md#decision).

Unresolved applicability: Does this decision still apply unchanged? Its owning implementation &
later resolutions were not revalidated while seeding issue #268.

### [Search result reveal](decisions/2026-10-27-search-reveal.md)

ID: 2026-10-27-search-reveal. Status: Needs review.

Both searches reveal every matching row automatically through the shared row-reveal controller,
without requiring scrolling or another action. Home search retains its ranked cross-category list &
category tags; category filters retain their section layout. Both keep the existing 200 ms input
debounce.

Evidence:
[docs/decisions/2026-10-27-search-reveal.md#decision](../docs/decisions/2026-10-27-search-reveal.md#decision).

Unresolved applicability: Does this decision still apply unchanged? Its owning implementation &
later resolutions were not revalidated while seeding issue #268.
